name: Basic Pancakes
instructions: Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar together in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter together.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk just until combined; a few small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or skillet over medium heat.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the griddle.
Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook until golden, another 1-2 minutes.
